draft.text: You came in because you hurt your right knee while skiing over the weekend.
You said you heard a pop and now have pain and swelling in your knee.
You have been using Advil and ice to help with the pain.
You haven't had any problems with your knee giving way or locking up.
You can put weight on your leg and don't have numbness or tingling.
You feel pain and tightness when you bend or straighten your knee.
You may have injured your knee ligaments or cartilage, but we didn't do any special tests today.
We will talk about what to do next during your next visit.
